rationale: The agent did not meet key policy requirements. Although it looked up the user by name and ZIP and retrieved their orders, it executed order-changing writes (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user. It also processed returns beyond the user's explicitly stated initial request (added Smart Watch and E-Reader) without confirmation. Furthermore, it failed to return both skateboards as requested—only one skateboard is listed as returned while another order (#W2598324) was retrieved but not acted upon. The agent also stated the refund would go to a credit card ending in 9375, a detail not supported by the tool outputs (only a payment_method_id was shown). These issues violate the requirements to confirm before writes, avoid unsupported details, and fully complete the user's request.
